baseline: C++17 unless variant explicitly names newer standard

patterns.title: 为同一数据选择正确的初始化形式
patterns.problem_scenario: 构造容器大小/填充值和列举元素，修复函数声明被误当对象构造
patterns.mechanism: default/value/direct/copy/list initialization meanings differ
important_variants: automatic scalar vs static zero initialization
user-provided default constructor may prevent zero-initializing members

patterns.title: 阻止隐式转换而保留显式构造
patterns.problem_scenario: 值包装类型不接受隐式整数/字符串转换
patterns.mechanism: explicit constructors participate differently in direct versus copy initialization
important_variants: T{x} vs T t=x vs T t={x}
open_questions: 完整的user-defined conversion ranking仍需具体重载题补读

patterns.title: 批量初始化move-only元素为何失败
patterns.problem_scenario: 构造vector<unique_ptr<T>>而不试图复制所有权
patterns.mechanism: initializer_list backing array elements are const; copying list view does not move elements

patterns.title: 让推导保留需要的引用与const
patterns.problem_scenario: 遍历/接收访问器结果时避免意外复制或丢只读约束
patterns.mechanism: by-value auto drops top-level cv/reference while auto&/const auto& bind

patterns.title: auto花括号的两条不同规则
patterns.problem_scenario: 识别auto x{1}和auto x={1}的真实类型
patterns.mechanism: C++17 direct-list deduction requires one element; copy-list produces initializer_list

patterns.title: 访问器/转发结果保值还是保引用
patterns.problem_scenario: 修复decltype(auto)因括号多一层而返回悬空引用
patterns.mechanism: unparenthesized named entity decltype differs from general expression category

patterns.title: 在运算之前提升类型
patterns.problem_scenario: 乘积、长度差和累加结果存入64位却仍溢出
patterns.mechanism: operand promotions and usual conversions determine intermediate type

patterns.title: 修复有符号与无符号混合比较
patterns.problem_scenario: 负索引与size_t比较产生反直觉结果
patterns.mechanism: rank and representability select common arithmetic type
important_variants: negative signed converts to unsigned in common cases
C++20 cmp_* alternative outside C++17 baseline

patterns.title: 负数整除与奇偶分类
patterns.problem_scenario: 修复对全部int输入用x%2==1判断奇数
patterns.mechanism: integer division truncates toward zero; remainder follows dividend sign
important_variants: zero divisor and unrepresentable quotient excluded

patterns.title: 按目标宽度构造位掩码
patterns.problem_scenario: 避免1<<k按int宽度运算及越界位移
patterns.mechanism: left operand promoted type and shift amount bounds are decisive
important_variants: signed negative right shift implementation-defined in C++17

patterns.title: 区分未指定顺序与未排序副作用
patterns.problem_scenario: 分析函数参数中多个修改、调用链和重载操作符
patterns.mechanism: C++17 parameter initializations indeterminately sequenced; call order still unspecified
important_variants: f(i++,i++) differs from pre17 UB classification
operator notation versus direct operator function call

patterns.title: 明确空指针传参的目标类型
patterns.problem_scenario: 重载f(int)/f(T*)时避免0或NULL走整数分支
patterns.mechanism: nullptr has its own type and converts to pointers

patterns.title: 同一接口接收左值和临时值
patterns.problem_scenario: 选择T&/const T&/T&&避免意外拒绝或修改
patterns.mechanism: reference compatibility and category govern binding
important_variants: const reference may bind conversion temporary
rvalue reference variable is named lvalue expression
reference does not rebind on assignment
patterns.proposed_section: 引用、生命周期与调用接口

patterns.title: 判断临时对象究竟活到哪里
patterns.problem_scenario: 返回借用结果或在对象中保存引用后避免悬空
patterns.mechanism: lifetime extension is syntactic and has explicit exceptions
patterns.proposed_section: 引用、生命周期与调用接口

patterns.title: 区分返回对象与返回内部借用
patterns.problem_scenario: 容器/类访问器返回引用或视图时明确拥有者
patterns.mechanism: reference return does not create ownership or renew lifetime
important_variants: consumer auto may copy while auto& borrows
patterns.proposed_section: 引用、生命周期与调用接口

patterns.title: 实现const与可修改访问器
patterns.problem_scenario: 同一索引检查供两个const重载复用
patterns.mechanism: object cv selects overload; controlled forwarding avoids duplicated logic
important_variants: as_const forwarding then cast only when original object nonconst
private helper versus template explicit object later

patterns.title: 为右值访问器返回独立值
patterns.problem_scenario: 优化临时对象取成员而不产生持久悬空引用
patterns.mechanism: &/&& ref-qualification reflects source lifetime; returning by value can transfer ownership
important_variants: rvalue getter returns value via move
return T&& safe only if consumer completes within owning temporary lifetime
patterns.proposed_section: 引用、生命周期与调用接口

patterns.title: 修复初始化次序依赖
patterns.problem_scenario: 成员b的初始化依赖a但声明顺序相反
patterns.mechanism: bases/members initialize before body and declaration order controls members
important_variants: constructor body assignment is a second operation
delegating constructor cannot initialize other members alongside target

patterns.title: 让成员负责资源而省掉五个特殊成员
patterns.problem_scenario: 给值对象添加动态数组/字符串而保持正确拷贝移动
patterns.mechanism: composing RAII members delegates special-member semantics
important_variants: user-declared destructor can suppress implicit move

patterns.title: 拥有缓冲区的独立值语义
patterns.problem_scenario: 为Buffer复制/赋值而不共享裸指针资源
patterns.mechanism: default memberwise pointer copy does not duplicate owned object
important_variants: shared ownership is different intended semantics

patterns.title: 先准备后提交的赋值
patterns.problem_scenario: 分配或复制抛异常时目标值保持不变
patterns.mechanism: allocate/copy temporary before no-throw commit
important_variants: copy-and-swap requires safe copy and nonthrowing swap/destruction

patterns.title: 实现move-only资源句柄
patterns.problem_scenario: 转移fd/heap buffer后恰好释放一次
patterns.mechanism: move acquires source ownership and leaves contractually valid source
important_variants: move construction has no old target
move assignment must dispose old resource

patterns.title: 让自移动赋值保持对象可析构
patterns.problem_scenario: x=std::move(x)不重复释放资源
patterns.mechanism: self-move is an API invariant question, not automatically same as copy
important_variants: standard library moved-from/self-move guarantees must be checked individually

patterns.title: std::move不执行资源转移
patterns.problem_scenario: 解释move调用后为何仍发生拷贝
patterns.mechanism: std::move changes expression category; selected constructor performs operation
important_variants: const T&& usually binds const T& copy
named T&& parameter is lvalue expression
type with no move may copy from rvalue

patterns.title: 使用移动后的对象而不假设内容
patterns.problem_scenario: 移动string后重新赋值/clear而非断言为空
patterns.mechanism: standard library default is valid but unspecified state
important_variants: user-defined move contract is separately designed

patterns.title: 判断编译器生成还是删除移动
patterns.problem_scenario: 增加析构函数后性能或可编译性变化
patterns.mechanism: user-declared special members affect implicit declarations; defaulted deleted move ignored in overload resolution
important_variants: explicit =delete move can block copy fallback
rule-of-five is design advice not mechanical obligation

patterns.title: 准确说明容器重分配的移动选择
patterns.problem_scenario: 让value type在vector扩容中保持异常保证
patterns.mechanism: noexcept and CopyInsertable determine available guarantees
important_variants: copy available and move may throw
move-only throwing type may still move
do not label entire container policy as only-noexcept-moves

patterns.title: 返回不可拷贝不可移动对象
patterns.problem_scenario: 工厂直接return T{}仍可用于C++17
patterns.mechanism: same-type prvalue initializes destination directly
important_variants: C++14 may require move/copy even if optimizer elides
base-subobject and other contexts are separate

patterns.title: 返回局部值时避免多余std::move
patterns.problem_scenario: 保留NRVO机会并理解不能强求构造次数
patterns.mechanism: named return optimization is optional; implicit move used when eligible
important_variants: conditional lvalue expression may cause copy

patterns.title: 唯一所有权的函数参数
patterns.problem_scenario: 消费对象用unique_ptr按值，借用对象用T&/T*
patterns.mechanism: parameter type should convey ownership contract
important_variants: const unique_ptr does not mean const pointee

patterns.title: 区分观察、替换与释放所有权
patterns.problem_scenario: 连接C API时正确使用智能指针三个接口
patterns.mechanism: get observes; reset disposes/replaces; release relinquishes responsibility
important_variants: release result must gain new owner
reset(get()) is invalid for unique ownership
borrowed aliases can still dangle after reset

patterns.title: 包装非new来源的资源
patterns.problem_scenario: FILE*/library buffer/fd按正确API释放
patterns.mechanism: RAII cleanup policy must match resource acquisition
important_variants: function pointer vs stateful callable deleter
make helpers do not accept custom deleter

patterns.title: 匹配单对象与数组删除
patterns.problem_scenario: 管理动态T[]而不发生new/delete[]不匹配
patterns.mechanism: allocation category determines destruction and deletion
important_variants: array deletion through base pointer invalid
prefer vector when it matches ownership needs

patterns.title: 同一raw pointer为何会重复释放
patterns.problem_scenario: 禁止对已拥有指针重建无关shared_ptr
patterns.mechanism: shared ownership is control-block identity, not pointer value equality

patterns.title: 保持外层对象活着但指向其成员
patterns.problem_scenario: 返回shared_ptr<Member>且共享Outer生命周期
patterns.mechanism: stored pointer and managed object/control block can differ
important_variants: get equality differs from ownership equality
member subobject lifetime still requires owner invariant

patterns.title: 弱观察与循环拥有
patterns.problem_scenario: 缓存/回调/父子图中不延长对象生命
patterns.mechanism: weak_ptr lock acquires temporary strong ownership atomically
important_variants: expired then use is not atomic acquisition
weak edge breaks strong ownership cycle
expired lock empty vs shared_ptr(weak) throws

patterns.title: 成员函数安全返回自身拥有者
patterns.problem_scenario: 避免shared_ptr(this)重复控制块
patterns.mechanism: enable_shared_from_this joins existing shared owner
important_variants: must already be owned before shared_from_this
weak_from_this may be empty and needs lock

patterns.title: 选择工厂返回值类型
patterns.problem_scenario: 同一工厂返回值、unique_ptr或shared_ptr
patterns.mechanism: value/reference identity and ownership intent decide interface
open_questions: 非多态工厂的原文最终答案未完整读取，值返回依据由标准与已读教材补证

patterns.title: 仅偶尔保留对象的参数
patterns.problem_scenario: 避免每次shared_ptr复制却仍能按需续命
patterns.mechanism: conditional retention differs from mandatory owning sink and plain borrowing
important_variants: const shared_ptr& can copy on needed branch
plain T& cannot manufacture owning control block

patterns.title: 置空一个指针不能修复所有别名
patterns.problem_scenario: 解释delete p;p=nullptr后q仍悬空
patterns.mechanism: pointer objects and pointed storage lifetimes are distinct
important_variants: observing weak handle can detect lifetime

patterns.title: 基类接口销毁正确动态对象
patterns.problem_scenario: unique_ptr<Base>管理Derived时基类析构契约
patterns.mechanism: C++17 delete through mismatched base requires virtual destructor
important_variants: protected nonvirtual base prevents public delete
shared_ptr remembers creation deleter in a different way; needs separate case

patterns.title: 构造析构期间虚调用的目标
patterns.problem_scenario: 避免基类构造调用依赖未构造派生状态
patterns.mechanism: call uses final overrider in current constructor/destructor class
important_variants: pure virtual call requires separate restriction

patterns.title: 传值切掉派生部分
patterns.problem_scenario: 异常和普通多态对象的值传递保留什么
patterns.mechanism: copy base subobject differs from reference/pointer dispatch
important_variants: return clone through owning base pointer

patterns.title: 对不支持输入给编译错误
patterns.problem_scenario: 保留double setter同时拒绝int隐式转换
patterns.mechanism: deleted exact-match overload can win overload resolution

patterns.title: 实现符合值语义的前后置++
patterns.problem_scenario: 修复IPv4后置++返回新值的原书实现
patterns.mechanism: prefix mutates and returns reference; postfix returns old value

patterns.title: 输入失败不破坏目标对象
patterns.problem_scenario: 修复IPv4的分隔符、数值范围和流状态检查
patterns.mechanism: parse into initialized temporaries then validate and commit
important_variants: failed extraction must be checked before reading separators

patterns.title: 闭区间达到最大值后停止
patterns.problem_scenario: IPv4枚举last=2^32-1时防止绕回0
patterns.mechanism: inclusive terminal condition must be tested before increment
important_variants: counter with wider sentinel only if representable

patterns.title: 构造半途失败的资源清理
patterns.problem_scenario: 第二个成员构造抛异常时第一个资源不能泄漏
patterns.mechanism: only fully constructed subobjects unwind; incomplete containing destructor not called
important_variants: new storage cleanup not same as owned resources

patterns.title: 重抛保留动态异常类型
patterns.problem_scenario: 修复throw e导致异常切片
patterns.mechanism: bare throw reuses active exception object; throw e constructs new static type
important_variants: wrap/nested exception is a distinct design

patterns.title: 异常处理由派生到基类
patterns.problem_scenario: 修复domain_error在logic_error之后无法命中的处理器
patterns.mechanism: first matching handler wins; inheritance affects matching
important_variants: handler changing object does not recreate exception

patterns.title: 正常返回和异常出口统一释放
patterns.problem_scenario: 去掉多分支中重复delete/close逻辑
patterns.mechanism: automatic RAII objects destruct in reverse construction completion order
important_variants: raw pointer local does not own cleanup

patterns.title: 析构失败如何报告而不炸掉展开
patterns.problem_scenario: 资源关闭错误由显式操作报告，析构保底清理
patterns.mechanism: escaping noexcept destructor or destructor during unwinding can terminate
important_variants: member destructor affects implicit exception specification

patterns.title: 把异常保证落实为可观察条件
patterns.problem_scenario: 给更新操作区分不抛/强/基本保证
patterns.mechanism: strong requires rollback/no observable state change plus basic invariants
important_variants: noexcept is not proof of successful work
I/O/external side effects may prevent rollback

patterns.title: C输出指针与RAII接管
patterns.problem_scenario: 调用int api(T**)后在成功路径安全接管
patterns.mechanism: status output and ownership state must agree before reset/commit
important_variants: failure cleanup convention must come from actual C API

patterns.title: 稳定接口隐藏拥有资源的实现
patterns.problem_scenario: Person练习9-4将接口与实现分离
patterns.mechanism: incomplete implementation and owning member special-member definition points
